queries: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_ratios AS (SELECT rating, avg_rental_rate / avg_replacement_cost AS ratio_of_averages, film_count FROM rating_averages) SELECT rating, ratio_of_averages, film_count, ratio_of_averages - AVG(ratio_of_averages) OVER () AS difference_from_rating_average FROM rating_ratios ORDER BY rating
